description: Enhance GitHub Actions CI pipeline (Task 1.3) and add pre-commit security gates (Task 1.4). Update the existing ci.yml with proper caching, add secret scanning with gitleaks, dependency vulnerability scanning, and SBOM generation.
steps: Update .github/workflows/ci.yml to add pnpm store caching using actions/cache with key based on pnpm-lock.yaml hash
Add security scanning job to CI: install and run gitleaks via docker action (gitleaks/gitleaks-action@v2) on all PRs
Add dependency vulnerability scanning step: run 'pnpm audit --audit-level=moderate' after install in the node job
Add pip-audit step in the python job: 'pip install pip-audit && pip-audit -r requirements.txt'
Add SBOM generation step using CycloneDX: install @cyclonedx/cyclonedx-npm and run 'pnpm dlx @cyclonedx/cyclonedx-npm --output-file sbom.json' then upload as artifact
Update .husky/pre-commit to also run typecheck on staged files via lint-staged (already handled by lint-staged config)
Add a 'security' script to root package.json: 'pnpm audit --audit-level=moderate'
acceptance_criteria: CI workflow includes pnpm caching with cache hit/miss
CI has a gitleaks secret scanning step
CI runs pnpm audit for Node dependency vulnerabilities
CI runs pip-audit for Python dependency vulnerabilities
CI generates a CycloneDX SBOM artifact
verification: cat .github/workflows/ci.yml and verify all jobs/steps are present
findings: CI enhanced with pnpm store caching (actions/cache@v4), gitleaks secret scanning job (gitleaks-action@v2), pnpm audit in node job, pip-audit in python job, and CycloneDX SBOM generation with artifact upload. Added 'security' script to root package.json. Pre-commit hook already runs lint-staged which handles eslint+prettier. All lint/typecheck pass clean.
